subject: PO tagging & SKU priority for vendor onboarding
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@bluehorizon.ai>, procurement@bluehorizon.ai
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO tagging & SKU priority for vendor onboarding

Hi Elena / Blue Horizon procurement team,

Thanks for getting set up with Redwood — excited to have you launching in our platform. Two items we need to finalize before the first invoice goes out:

1) PO issuance: Finance will issue a PO number for the engagement, but we need to confirm whether you require separate POs per invoice type (software subscription vs. professional services). Our standard workflow can either:
  - split into two distinct POs (one for software SKU codes, one for services), or
  - issue one PO with line-item tagging so invoices can be routed by charge code.

2) Spend cap / provisional coverage: Your onboarding notes mention a $50k monthly spend cap. If the first-month onboarding labor exceeds that cap we can issue a provisional PO to avoid blocking the initial invoice, then follow up with official PO issuance.

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and sku_lineitems_v1.xlsx (initial line-item mapping). Can you confirm which PO approach you prefer and whether your AR system requires separate PO fields per invoice? If you prefer split POs, please confirm how you want the line items divided.

Next steps: once you confirm, I will open the PO request with Finance (cc'd: Monica) and request a provisional number if required.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.ai

From: Elena Morales <elena@bluehorizon.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluehorizon.ai, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO tagging & SKU priority for vendor onboarding

Hi Sean — thanks for the clear note.

We need two separate PO numbers from Redwood. Our AR system (internal ERP) requires a single PO reference per invoice and we cannot attach multiple PO references to a single invoice line. Practically that means: one PO for the subscription/license (monthly recurring SKU lines) and a second PO for professional services (onboarding/migration/one-time fees).

On spend cap: we can operate under the $50k cap, but the professional services estimate for month one is $72,500. If you can provide a provisional PO covering the overage that would prevent invoice delays.

Attached: vendor_invoice_requirements.pdf (shows the PO field constraints). Also: please send vendor tax and billing address so we can create your vendor record on our side.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Finance Operations
Blue Horizon AI
elena@bluehorizon.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO tagging & SKU priority for vendor onboarding

Thanks @Sean and Elena for the clarifications. Quick internal note and proposed plan:

- Vendor requires two POs (software vs. services).
- For month one we should issue:
  * PO-RED-8342-SW — covers subscription SKUs up to $50k
  * PROV-RED-8342-SVC — provisional PO for services covering the $22,500 overage (to be reconciled when Finance issues the final PO)
- Finance / Legal: Aditya, please confirm that we can create a provisional PO with the "PROV-" prefix and reconcile next billing cycle; also confirm whether we need contract addendum for provisional coverage.
- Action: Sean to request vendor tax ID and billing address (Elena provided previously; please confirm). Karthik to preserve the deal_id on all paperwork so sales/CS attribution remains.

I will begin the internal PO request once Aditya confirms.

Monica Patel
Senior Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@bluehorizon.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO tagging & SKU priority for vendor onboarding

Appreciate the fast movement here. A couple of points from sales side:

- Please ensure both POs reference DEAL-8342 in the PO memo field so revenue recognition links correctly.
- If Finance would prefer a single PO we could alternatively do one PO with two invoice line groups and an internal sub-tag ("svc" vs "sw") — but I know that wouldn't work for Blue Horizon's ERP per Elena.
- If provisional PO is issued, add a note: "Provisional PO to be replaced by final PO-RED-8342-SVC upon Finance approval". That helps AR reconcile later.

If Finance confirms provisional OK, let's go ahead.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
